admission.justification: The requirement weighed per-turn filtering, private-table mutation, configuration edits and list-only filtering against static construction-time narrowing, and the choice binds every later change to a role's tool surface.

alternatives.option: Narrow each role-launched task server once at construction from one static per-role table, removing excluded tools through FastMCP's public remove_tool, and grant a fresh Codex seat the same ordered list.
alternatives.reason: A static surface keeps the tool list stable across turns for the harness prompt cache, gives least-privilege discovery and dispatch from one table, and brings the Architect's eager schema under antigravity-acp's pack size.

alternatives.option: Filter the advertised tools per turn.
alternatives.reason: Every change of the tool list breaks the harness's prompt cache.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Harnesses keep their prompt cache across changes of the tool list.

alternatives.option: Remove tools by mutating FastMCP's private tool table.
alternatives.reason: It couples the server to FastMCP internals while the locked mcp release offers a public remove_tool.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The supported mcp release no longer offers a public way to remove a registered tool.

alternatives.option: Edit the user's Codex or Antigravity configuration at launch.
alternatives.reason: It writes user configuration, which the single-server rule forbids, and changes concurrent sessions of the developer.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The developer admits a launch-time change to user harness configuration.

alternatives.option: Hide tools in list_tools only and keep them callable.
alternatives.reason: A hidden tool stays callable through call_tool, so the narrowing would not hold at dispatch.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The host itself enforces the advertised tool list at dispatch.

consequences: A tool added to PUBLIC_TOOLS reaches a role only when that role's table entry names it.
A seat started from an earlier saved launch call keeps the grant recorded at its start.
context: Every role-launched agents-remember-task server registered all 44 public tools and every Codex seat was granted all of them, which bloated each seat's first turn and made antigravity-acp drop its largest tools, including task_doc and role_start.
decider: The developer, through decisions D971, D972, D974, D976 and D979, which approved CAP-R01@v1.
